svg.title: SEARCH AUTOCOMPLETE: sketchnote
svg.text: Suggestions on every keystroke within 100 ms: the work has to be done before
~100k req/s at < 10 ms rules out queries:
Trie with top 10 at every node, in RAM,
Streaming overlay for trends; client debounce
walk to "ca" node → read its top 10 → ~1 ms
Logs → Kafka → aggregate with decay → trie builder → snapshot
→ suggest servers; trending merged at serve time.
GROUP BY + LIKE per keystroke scans millions of rows.
Time-decayed popularity per language and region;
Block list at serve time + spare candidates per
Fine for results pages; too costly per keystroke
"Every node of an offline-built trie stores its top
10, so a suggestion is a 1 ms walk in memory; the
client debounces, the CDN caches short prefixes,
and a streaming job overlays trending queries."
DDIA: Ch 11 batch-built indexes · Ch 12 trending counts · Similar: Post search · Top-K videos
